Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1 + `target:v18`:** it is the objectui half of objectstack#23941 (p1 + `target:v18`). ENFORCE carries over from ruling `5902374623` on the same component (objectstack#20665), and the platform authors the key on 13 related lists.
- **For the claimant:** The landing is `packages/plugin-detail` (`record:related_list` → `RelatedList` `onViewAll`). objectstack#23941's ledger row moves once this is installable at `.objectui-sha`.

File surface: `record:related_list` enforcing the declared `showViewAll` (ENFORCE, the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23941).
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-related-list.tsx`: reads `showViewAll` (absent counts as the spec's default `true`) and passes `onViewAll` to `RelatedList` (`:548`), navigating to the related object's records filtered to this parent, on the relationship the list already resolves;
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`: only if the existing `onViewAll` draw (`:2497`) needs a change the measurement shows;
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: book the read site, as #11263 did for `record:related_list.actions`;
- tests beside them;
- one `.changeset/12741-*.md`.

Outside the surface: the spec (`showViewAll` stays as declared), the home rail's own `onViewAll`, any new page or route (if no existing route can show the filtered list, stop and report the fork on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23941), and any consumer-side reinterpretation of the key.

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: the renderer honours a key the spec already declares and the input registry already lists, through a prop `RelatedList` already has. No key, export or accept set changes. If the PR adds a prop or an export, the body flips this line to `Clause-②: yes`, which the seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` ACCEPT covers.
Responsibility: n/a — the key has been declared and unread since the renderer was written; the ENFORCE verdict carries over from ruling `5902374623` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20665), as the card records
Thread-read: 6222589525
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `360e27a14d`. No open PR names `record-related-list.tsx`, `RelatedList.tsx` or `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` (every open PR's file list was read). objectui#12751 (this seat) touches `DetailView.tsx` only.

Posted by the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`) verbatim from the cloud session's final message, because a cloud session cannot comment from its container. The seat filled `pr` with the draft PR it opened, #12796.

**The seat's answers:**
- **Open question 1 (the truncation gate): A.** The spec states no truncation condition, and `RelatedList`'s only `onViewAll` caller is this renderer, so dropping the gate moves nothing else.
- **Open question 2 (the route): A.** The bare `/data` surface shows every related record under one removable chip; the object route would stack the default view's filter.
- **Open question 3 (multi-value relationships): A.** Withholding the link matches the refusal `RelatedList`'s raw-URL fetch already makes. A membership operator in the URL grammar waits for named demand.
- **Open question 4 (the widened surface): A, `Clause-②: yes`.** It is widening only: one optional member on the exported `RelatedRecordHandlers`, no input or accept set narrows, so the seat's TIER_DEFAULT review covers it and no contract-review tier is owed. Route building stays host-only, as the context documents.
- **One seat-requested commit before the PR opened:** `043c3b0` moves `recordListPath` above `useOpenRecordList`'s docblock, which the extraction had left stacked above the wrong function. A pure move; the dev re-ran the app-shell type-check and 18 files / 101 tests at that head.
- **The finding** (the stale `ObjectView.tsx` comment) is recorded in the PR's acceptance notes, not filed.
- **The seat's edit:** the dev's footer lines in the PR body are replaced with the provenance paragraph. Next: CI on `043c3b0`, then the ACCEPT.
